reconcile.note: Henry treats the veil's tearing as happening at the very moment Jesus died, so the Gospels record one simultaneous event rather than a strict before-and-after sequence.

sides.snippet: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.
sides.verseText: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

sides.snippet: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.
